content.rendered:
Our Back to School Night will be held on Thursday, September 21st from 6-7:30pm. A video was sent out to families yesterday, but you can view it here. 

We are trying a new format this year, which we’re excited about! Students and parents/guardians can visit classrooms and specialists (in Gym 1) anytime between 6:00-6:45. While in classrooms, teachers will have a variety of activities/things to do or see that showcase that specific grade level.  At 6:45, a picnic style dinner will be served in the cafeteria for families and staff to eat and visit. Thank you to Journey Church for donating the meals!
